researchEvidence.note: Official Department of Health page reviewed; it directs users to lookup asbestos abatement companies and states those companies are licensed to perform asbestos abatement in Vermont.
Official Department of Health page reviewed; it states contractors performing RRPM work for hire need the Lead-Safe RRPM Firm license and at least one RRPM supervisor.
State portal policies reviewed for general privacy, disclaimer, and linking posture.
